description: Maryland MVA identification card presented in Senate Bill 87 testimony. The two subfiles terminate immediately after the final value. The ZMA element is opaque.

provenance.verifiedBy: ZXing-C++ and Apple Vision decoded the same original payload digest. Six original value spans were replaced independently of the application, preserving all widths and framing.
provenance.anonymization: The issuer labels this MDOT Sample MD ID Product, visibly overprints SAMPLE, and supplies dummy segmented LASTNAME and TESTING values. The issuer obscured the customer number and street/address on its visible front. The reusable fixture masks the customer number, address, ZIP, document discriminator and inventory control number, keeping each byte span and identifier shape. The fixture retains the fabricated specimen names. No original bytes or reusable optical crop are included.
provenance.notes: See the November continuation intake for disclosure, hashes and exact replacement spans. The retained 299-byte reference is anonymized.
